updates.title: A fix, and this page
items: Fixed: a check handed in by a reload now shows its questions.
What's new: this page.

updates.title: Figures, the class chat, Listen
items: Figures in the reader, drawn for this course.
The class chat: your section's room, and a private thread with your instructor.
Listen: the reader reads a stage aloud, following the voice sentence by sentence.
Forgot your password? Reset it yourself by email.
Leaving a check or an exam once it has started hands it in with the answers you gave.

updates.title: Look around the map
items: Zoom and look around the map; it returns home after 30 seconds.
Orientation is finished when you read it to the end.
An alien rides a comet's orbit. Click it.

updates.title: A realistic solar system
items: A longer warp, then an arrival screen for every planet and moon.
A more realistic solar system: smaller planets, wider orbits, a bigger sun and distant comets.

updates.title: Two more minigames, real textures
items: Cache Tuner, moon 04.5's drill, on the book's own Example 4.2.
Bus Contention, moon 03.9's bus wiring game.
Real textures on the map's planets, moons and sun.

updates.title: OCTA becomes a game
items: A new look: a star HUD on the map, and each planet's biome when you open it.
A check now starts behind a Start button, in full screen, with no way back until you submit.
Moons: practise each objective on its moon; mastering them opens the next planet.
Two minigames: Two Columns (moon 01.2) and Clock Bench (moon 02.8).
A new title screen for signing in.

updates.title: The reader and the check, rebuilt
items: The stage reader and the check rebuilt.
A check you come back to keeps the answers you had given.
A locked stage says what opens it.

updates.title: An icon of its own
items: OCTA has its own icon in the browser tab.

updates.title: Stage checks
items: Each stage has a check to pass before the next one opens.
Fixed: ordering questions can now be answered.

updates.title: A fix in the check
items: Fixed: multiple-choice answers in a check were rejected.

updates.title: Biomes, and arriving at a stage
items: New biome art for the planets: arctic, ocean, cave and more.
Opening a stage travels to it and shows where you have arrived.

updates.title: Planet panels and the stages list
items: A planet panel, with its moons.
A Stages page, and a first-run tour (press ? to see it again).
Phones in landscape work.

updates.title: The solar system
items: The map is a solar system: each stage is a planet.
Your system has its own look and callsign (see Settings).
Planets have biomes.

updates.title: Chapters 2 to 7, and labs
items: Chapters 2 to 7 can be read.
Hand in labs and the project.

updates.title: CPE 412, and your first assessment
items: The course follows CPE 412's 18 chapters.
Sign in and sit an assessment.

updates.title: The beginning
items: Sign in and see the course as a map of stages.
